Thread Safety:
Thread-safe
Header file:
#include "ara/crypto/cryp/crypto_context.h"
Description:
Clear the crypto context and set the domain parameters to it.
Notes:
If domain parameters are principally required for a crypto algorithm assigned to the context
then they must be set before loading of a key value (if it is a keyed context)!
If (params == nullptr) then this method only clears the crypto context.
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kIncompatibleObject if provided domain parameters object is
incompatible with an algorithm assigned to this cryptographic context
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kIncompleteArgState if provided domain parameters object has
incomplete state
